title: A new triage watches the waiting page as its first act
why: Measured Oct 30 12:32 and 12:34 CDT (shiv's two test saves on item 9): a Save posts a comment sent to Claude, and it woke only the sessions that watch the page, from any device. The watch belongs to the session; it ends when triage rotates. The waiting-page skill makes a session watch only when it adds an item, so a new triage that inherits items and adds none hears no Save until it next publishes the page.
note: Ruling, Oct 30 12:35 CDT (shiv, chat): yes, file it. Fix: in skills/waiting-page/SKILL.md (the watch rule near the item-adding rule) and the triage rotation steps, a session that takes over the page writer role or inherits open items runs ArtifactComments watch on the page URL first, and the handoff names that watch. Done check: a test or check that fails when a triage handoff with open items names no page watch. Needs no answer. Port: yes, the skill installs everywhere. Placed ahead of c95 (triage 12, Oct 30): a gap every rotation hits.
